paper.title: SAM ViT-H trained on SA-1B (Section 3 / Appendix A)

note: Architecture (windowed ViT-H with 4 global blocks, 256-d embedding, 2-layer two-way decoder, 3+1 mask tokens), the 20:1 focal:dice loss and 11-round interactive simulation follow the paper. Optimiser values (AdamW lr 8e-4, warmup 250, 90k iterations, batch 256, step decay, weight decay 0.1, drop path 0.4, layer decay 0.8) are best-recalled from Appendix A and must be checked; step decay, layer decay and drop path are not wired into train.py yet. The image encoder must be initialised from an MAE-pretrained ViT-H (not included). SA-1B loader not included.
